name: Soft-force Chord with token-indexed initial velocity
tagline: One learnable initial tangent velocity per vocabulary item.
description: Look up a token-specific velocity, project it into the tangent plane at the post-smear position and apply the native soft-force Chord updates.
mechanism: Zero-initialized untied token velocity table in the input embedding optimizer group
Shared Triton tangent projection with BF16 states and FP32 reductions
Update-based soft force and h-only controls
